steps.en: Install the complete Antigravity plugin and open a new session
steps.zh: 在 Antigravity 安装完整插件，开启新会话

steps.en: Describe a feature with real design decisions
steps.zh: 描述一个需要架构取舍的功能
steps.code: /egm-brainstorm Add webhook delivery to this project.

steps.en: Challenge the idea with fresh reviewers and save concepts_brief.md
steps.zh: 用全新审查者挑战概念，保存概念简报

steps.en: Choose architectural tradeoffs and approve the direction
steps.zh: 选择架构取舍，批准设计方向

steps.en: Start drafting and review each section as it is written
steps.zh: 启动起草，逐节审阅并批准

steps.en: Build design_draft.md from the brief and approved sections
steps.zh: 依据简报与已批准章节构造设计草稿

steps.en: Review the actual returned draft path
steps.zh: 审查实际返回的草稿路径

steps.en: Run five ordered review stages and save findings and proposed text repairs
steps.zh: 依次执行五阶段审查，保存问题与文本修复建议

component.zh: 审查、审查循环与裁决技能

steps.en: Approve needed edits and the design; authorize implementation and real tests separately
steps.zh: 批准所需修改与设计；另行授权实现及真实测试

value.en: A written design and review trail that do not rely on the author's chat history
value.zh: 拿到不依赖作者聊天背景的设计文件与审查记录
